generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: stems to 10 m tall, 11 to 25 cm across; leaves 1.5 to 2.5 m long, the petiole 30 to 50 cm; leaflets in 75 to 100 pairs, 20 to 28 cm by 12 to 16 mm, at 60 to 80 degrees. Drawn as a trunk 0.09 m in radius, rising 0.06 m a year; fronds 2 m long, the petiole 0.2 of them, 88 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.12 of the frond; 12 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 8 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records).

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: stems to 10 m tall, 11 to 25 cm across; leaves 1.5 to 2.5 m long, the petiole 30 to 50 cm; leaflets in 75 to 100 pairs, 20 to 28 cm by 12 to 16 mm, at 60 to 80 degrees. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 5.5 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: male cone narrowly ovoid, 35 to 55 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: male cone 10 to 15 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: microsporophylls about 5.6 cm long, the face about 1.7 by 1.6 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: male cone narrowly ovoid.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: male cone pale fawn to pale orange-brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.microsporophyll_spine_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: microsporophylls about 5.6 cm, the face about 1.7 by 1.6 cm, the spine reduced, sharply upturned, about 2 mm.

traits.megasporophyll_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: megasporophylls 18 to 35 cm long.

traits.megasporophyll_crown.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: megasporophylls loose and open.

traits.megasporophyll_margin.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: lamina narrowly triangular, 5 to 7.5 cm by 3 to 4 cm, with up to 16 lateral spines to 4 mm or mere bumps, and an apical spine 1 to 2.5 cm; read as toothed.

traits.megasporophyll_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: megasporophylls felted grey and orange; the colour by eye.

traits.ovules_per_megasporophyll.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: 4 to 8 ovules.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: seeds flattened ovoid, 4.5 to 5.8 cm long, with a spongy layer that floats them.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: seeds 3.5 to 4.5 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: sarcotesta orange when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 141), Cycas rumphii: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).

sources.title: Whitelock, L. M. (2002). The Cycads. Timber Press.
